name: Teapot with Symbols of England, Ireland, and Scotland
description: Palette extracted from “Teapot with Symbols of England, Ireland, and Scotland” by Staffordshire, England (c. 1830), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 5407. 3–5 semantic variants, glass/glitch effects.
changelog: 1.1.0 — source-backed design object palette; 3–5 variants; glass or glitch.
